    Hook and cohook maps as graph components #

    The canonical hook and cohook maps are carried by the single coefficient component pairing every old word position with its inherited position in the extended word. This file identifies those maps with literal vectors in the compiled graph-component basis. It is the coefficient-level input for the remaining irreducible-factorization argument.
